cases.sentence: Посылайте ягнят в дань правителю из ___.
cases.explain: The genitive case indicates the source or origin: from Selah.
The transitive verb дай (give) requires the accusative object.
The transitive verb спрячь requires the accusative object.
The preposition от (from) requires the genitive case.
The noun престол is the subject of the verb утвердится (will be established).

cases.sentence: Воссядет на него в истине ___, ищущий справедливость.
cases.explain: The noun правитель is the subject of the verb воссядет (will sit).

cases.sentence: Слышали мы о ___ Моава, о его непомерной гордости.
cases.explain: The preposition о (about) requires the prepositional case.
The preposition о can govern the accusative when expressing regret or concern.

reading.ru: Посылайте ягнят в дань правителю страны из Селы, через пустыню.
reading.question: What tribute should be sent and from where?
options: Lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land from Selah through the wilderness
Gold and silver to the king
Food and supplies to the temple
reading.correct: Lambs as tribute to the ruler of the land from Selah through the wilderness
reading.explain: The text directly commands sending lambs through the wilderness from Selah.

reading.ru: Дай нам совет, прими решение, сделай в полдень тень свою, ночеподобной.
reading.question: What requests are being made in this verse?
options: Give counsel, make decisions, and provide shade at noon like night
Send an army to defend us
reading.correct: Give counsel, make decisions, and provide shade at noon like night
reading.explain: The text explicitly requests counsel, decision-making, and providential protection.

reading.question: What command is given regarding fugitives?
options: Hide the exiles and do not betray the fugitives
Send them back to their homes
reading.correct: Hide the exiles and do not betray the fugitives
reading.explain: The text directly commands protecting and hiding those who have fled.

reading.ru: Когда притеснителю придет конец, прекратится опустошение.
reading.question: What will happen when the oppressor is ended?
options: Destruction will cease and devastation will stop
reading.correct: Destruction will cease and devastation will stop
reading.explain: The verse describes that when oppression ends, destruction and devastation will also cease.

reading.ru: Слышали мы о гордости Моава, о его непомерной гордости и тщеславии.
reading.question: What quality of Moab is repeatedly emphasized?
reading.explain: The text repeatedly mentions Moab's pride, excessive arrogance, and vain boasting.

reading.ru: Поэтому плачут моавитяне, все вместе оплакивают Моав.
reading.question: How do the Moabites respond to their situation?
options: They weep and mourn together for Moab
They make sacrifices in the temple
reading.correct: They weep and mourn together for Moab
reading.explain: The text explicitly states the Moabites weep and lament together for Moab.
